messages:
amanda_cs: Quick heads-up — I'm proposing a compact SLA handoff playbook for mid-market onboarding before the renewal pulse next quarter. Current problem: playbook has 12 triggers and handoff ownership is scattered across three tables. We need to reduce noise and ensure every account has a single enablement owner in CRM by next Wednesday.

joseph_csm: +1. Can you scope the minimal triggers we absolutely need? I'm worried about missing renewal signals.

amanda_cs: Minimal set I had in mind: (1) activation within 14 days, (2) product usage < 20% of expected, (3) missed enablement session, (4) NPS < 7 post-onboard, (5) billing mismatch flag, (6) stalled professional services ticket. That's 6 triggers.

priyanka_ops: Sounds reasonable. For ownership mapping, what's the authoritative field we should write to? owner_id or enablement_owner_email?

amanda_cs: owner_id in CRM (sf_account.owner_id) — that's what downstream playbooks read. We should write a normalization step that prefers CSM owner, falling back to enablement rep if unassigned.

ben_devex: I can add a small automation that takes a CSV mapping and runs a dry-run. Example CSV header we expect:

```
account_id,cs_owner_email,enablement_owner_email,priority
001A,joe@redwood.com,emma@redwood.com,high
001B,,nina@redwood.com,medium
```

ben_devex: The script will output a preview and delta rows with suggested owner_id changes.

joseph_csm: Important: please flag accounts with healthscore delta > 0.15 as high risk. We don't want owners to miss surprise churn risk.

amanda_cs: Agreed. Also add a rule: if healthscore is unknown, mark for manual review and assign a temp owner 'cs-queue@redwood.com' so playbook alerts still route.

playbook-bot: playbook-runner scheduled a dry-run: compact-sla-handoff v1 at 2026-03-30 18:20 UTC. 1,234 accounts processed. Preview CSV: /runbooks/compact-sla-handoff/preview-5501239876.csv

priyanka_ops: I'll own the manual review queue and coordinate with CSMs to finalize owners next Tue. @joseph_csm can you confirm you'll send the renewal-target list by EOD Monday?

joseph_csm: Yep — pulling the list now, will upload to the shared drive and ping here when ready. :thumbsup:

amanda_cs: Timeline recap: ben will run dry-run by Fri, playbook-bot will post preview, priyanka will triage manual bucket next Tue, final write to owner_id scheduled Wed 03:00 UTC with a canary of 50 accounts first. Rollback plan: revert owner_id from backup table and re-run playbook-runner rollback job.

ben_devex: Implemented cron: `0 3 * * 3 /opt/playbook/bin/compact_handoff --canary=50 --apply` — will include a `--no-apply` flag for preview. I'll drop the runbook and command in ops-runbook doc.

joseph_csm: Thanks all. One ask — can we get a quick viz of owner-distribution after canary? small chart to confirm no one person gets >40% of assignments.

priyanka_ops: Will do — adding a quick query to the preview job to surface that metric.

amanda_cs: Perfect. Thanks team — ping me if blockers come up. :rocket:
